about_the_game:
The Season Pass allows you to purchase all currently available and future additional DLC for “FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL,” at a discounted price in one bundle.

This Season Pass includes the following additional DLC:

※The DLC included in this Season Pass is equivalent to the content of the ‘FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL - COMPLETE DLC BUNDLE’.

Please be aware of duplicate purchases with individual DLCs and individual DLC bundles.

※If you have already purchased individual DLC or individual DLC bundles, using the ‘FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL - COMPLETE DLC BUNDLE’

will allow you to purchase the following DLC at the same price as this Season Pass without duplicate purchases.

■Additional Accessory

1) Accessory: "Dopey Panda" in 2 Color Varieties

2) Accessory: "Victory Daruma" in 2 Color Varieties

3) Accessory: "Grey Alien" in 2 Color Varieties

4) Accessory: "Cat Tail" in 2 Color Varieties

5) Accessory: "Raccoon Tail" in 2 Color Varieties

6) Accessory: "Fox Tail" in 2 Color Varieties

7) Assorted Colorful Accessories Set

8) Accessory: "Now I'm Pissed Cat" in 3 Color Varieties will be added.

■additional Costume

9)Ryoko Costume: Aya's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN"

10)"Cheerleader" Costume in 2 Color Varieties (usable by either Machine Girl)

11)"Hot Nurse" Costume in 2 Color Varieties (usable by either Machine Girl)

12)"Bunny Girl" Costume in 2 Color Varieties (partially usable by either Machine Girl)

13)Change your costume!

14)Ryoko Costume: "Cute Bikini" in 3 Color Varieties

15)Akemi Costume: "Cool Bikini" in 3 Color Varieties

16)"Sailor Bikini" Costume in 2 Color Varieties (usable by either Machine Girl)

17)"Old-Fashioned Swimsuit" (usable by either Machine Girl)

■additional Feature

18)New Feature: "Set the theme song as background music!"
